messages:
hiro: Onboarding gulliver-slim PTQ-4 to canary. Seeing structured-toolcall JSON objects get partially dropped when streaming is on. Small log snippet below.

anita: Oof. Can you paste raw stream fragments?

hiro: Yep. Repro chunks (order preserved):

```
{"type":"chunk","text":"{\"call_id\":\"c10\",\"result\":{\"ok\":true,\"actions\":[{\"type\":\"save\",\"params\":{\"path\":\"/tmp/x\",\"}"}
```

```
{"type":"chunk","text":"\"mode\":\"binary\"}}]}},\"meta\":{}}\n"}
```

hiro: When we reassemble sometimes parser sees `actions` as null, sometimes parse error. fp16 is ~0.5% fail; PTQ-4 ~4%.

ben: Sounds like streaming cut at subtoken boundary. Also check if runtime shard boundaries align with chunking.

anita: Quick mitigation: add a small sentinel wrapper at model output like `[[JSON]]...[[/JSON]]`. Cuts failures but adds ~30ms.

hiro: We tried that: failures down to ~0.3% but latency up. Not great for p95 SLO.

ben: Longer term: two things: (1) length-prefixed ndjson frames at runtime ingress so parser doesn't depend on chunk boundaries, (2) on-parse-fail fallback to non-streaming with cached prompt.

anita: Agreed. Also propose a microbenchmark: N=2000 prompts across fp16, PTQ-4, and hybrid-quant; adversarial chunk-split harness to simulate worst-case token cuts. Measure parse-fail, retries, extra latency, and tokens.

hiro: I'll run the harness today with `streaming=true` vs `streaming=false` and with/without sentinel. Posting results here.

deploy-bot: deploy 6390012345: feature flag `stream_framing=length_prefixed` NOT set. Canary monitoring enabled.

anita: Ben, can you sketch the ndjson length-prefix + 4-byte CRC idea? We can prototype it in the harness.

ben: Will do. Simple format: <4-byte big-endian length><payload><4-byte CRC32>. Runtime will reassemble by reading length then payload, ignoring boundary cuts. I'll push a tiny harness sim that injects adversarial splits.

hiro: Thank you. Will report back with numbers. :thumbsup:
